apps.localizedDescription: Scan a barcode or search to find the Plaisio product code, price and store stock.
apps.versionDescription: New in More: Stock count (Απογραφή). Scan the count list's pages, or add photos of them, and the AI reads each product's code and its Ράφι number. Then scan the boxes one at a time: a box counts once when its barcode comes into the aim. Every product shows counted / Ράφι, green when they match and red until then, with All / Wrong / Right and the pages still to scan. A box whose barcode isn't known yet is looked up, or you pick its product from the list, and every phone learns it. Tap a product to correct its numbers; Undo takes back the last box. The count stays on the phone until you start a new one.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan EAN barcodes to find the Plaisio product code.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turns what you say into text to find it on the Chania shelf.
